d: Donald Trump’s political standing faces a crucial test as Republicans confront mounting risks ahead of the midterm elections. From Kansas and Texas to key battlegrounds across the country, Democrats see openings to challenge Republican strongholds. Slipping approval ratings, rising living costs, tariffs and the Iran war are putting pressure on Trump’s promise to make America affordable again. Despite Republicans’ fundraising and advertising advantages, vulnerable seats are forcing the party to spend heavily on defence. Could a Democratic blue wave reshape Congress, stall Trump’s agenda and…
